title: Support for Broadcast of Research-based Children’s Educational Programming on Free-to-air Television Channels
what_it_is: Support for Broadcast of Research-based Children’s Educational Programming on Free-to-air Television Channels

sections.label: Media strategy for young children
sections.summary: Asked whether the Ministry will develop a media strategy to improve young children's outcomes through subsidising or supporting research-based educational programming on free-to-air television or online.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education whether the Ministry will develop a media strategy for improving educational and psychosocial developmental outcomes in young children through subsidising or supporting the broadcast of research-based educational programming on free-to-air television channels or online provision.

sections.label: Singapore Student Learning Space resources
sections.summary: From primary level, all students get educational resources via the Singapore Student Learning Space, rolled out to all schools in 2018, containing MOE and school media content and curated external content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: From the primary level, all students are given access to educational resources via the Singapore Student Learning Space, an online platform that was rolled out to all schools in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The resources on this platform contain media content developed inhouse by MOE and schools, as well as content curated from external sources, including free-to-air television channels and online media.

sections.label: Standards for educational programming
sections.summary: Asked whether the Ministry will develop standards for what counts as educational programming to guide free-to-air television channels.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry look into developing standards for what counts as educational programming for the purpose of guiding the free-to-air television channels, for example?

sections.label: Preschool ICT teaching guidelines
sections.summary: MOE developed teaching and learning guidelines on the use of information and communication technology in preschool centres in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, MOE has developed a set of teaching and learning guidelines on the use of information and communication technology (ICT) in preschool centres in 2017.

sections.label: Cyber Wellness Programme in schools
sections.summary: There are programmes such as the Cyber Wellness Programme in schools to enable students to make a choice that brings goodness in their lives.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At the same time, we have certain programmes, for example, the Cyber Wellness Programme in schools, to enable them to make a choice, a choice that will bring them goodness in their lives.
